title: Chef de Partie (Breakfast)
description_text:
We are looking for a talented Chef de Partie (Breakfast) to join our kitchen team in St. Julian's. You will prepare and present breakfast dishes to the highest standards, ensuring every guest starts their day with a memorable experience.
 What You will Do 
 Prepare hot and cold breakfast dishes, including buffet and à la carte items.
 Ensure food quality, presentation, and consistency.
 Maintain a clean, safe, and hygienic kitchen.
 Assist in stock management and ordering supplies.
 Support and mentor junior kitchen staff.
 What Were Looking For 
 2+ years of experience in a similar role, preferably in hotel breakfast service.
 Strong culinary skills with attention to detail.
 Knowledge of food hygiene and safety standards.
 Ability to work early mornings, weekends, and public holidays.
 Fluency in English; additional languages a plus.
 What We Offer 
 Competitive salary and performance bonuses.
 Opportunities for career growth and development.
 Supportive and dynamic team environment.
 Employee discounts on hotel services.
 Passionate about breakfast and delivering culinary excellence? Apply now and join our team in St. Julian's!
